description_target.target_text: Nested rect placement: largest rect = output container, smaller rects placed by aligning shared color markers

racket_target.raw_code:
(rule!
 ;; Crop the largest multicolor object as the canvas.  Every smaller piece
 ;; shares one marker color with that canvas; paste it at the unique window
 ;; whose marker cells match exactly.  Process pieces largest-first.
 (lambda (g)
   (define bg (mode g))
   (define objs
     (sort (objects-multicolor g bg)
           (lambda (a b) (> (obj-size a) (obj-size b)))))
   (define container (first objs))
   (define c-fill (mode-in (obj-cells container) g bg))
   (define (palette grid)
     (reverse
      (remove-duplicates
       (filter (lambda (v) (not (= v bg))) (apply append grid)))))
   (define (place out obj)
     (define piece (crop-object g obj))
     (define ph (rows piece))
     (define pw (cols piece))
     (define marker
       (find-first
        (lambda (v) (and (not (= v c-fill)) (member? v (palette out))))
        (palette piece)))
     (if (not marker)
         out
         (let* ((piece-marks (find-color piece marker))
                (hit
                 (find-first
                  (lambda (off)
                    (define dr (first off))
                    (define dc (second off))
                    (equal?
                     piece-marks
                     (for*/list ((r (range 0 ph)) (c (range 0 pw))
                                 #:when (= (at out (+ dr r) (+ dc c)) marker))
                       (list r c))))
                  (for*/list ((dr (range 0 (+ 1 (- (rows out) ph))))
                              (dc (range 0 (+ 1 (- (cols out) pw)))))
                    (list dr dc)))))
           (if hit
               (paint-cells
                out
                (for*/list ((r (range 0 ph)) (c (range 0 pw))
                            #:when (not (= (at piece r c) bg)))
                  (list (+ r (first hit)) (+ c (second hit)) (at piece r c))))
               out))))
   (foldl (lambda (piece out) (place out piece))
          (crop-object g container)
          (rest objs))))
